facts.statement: SOE announced special offers for Free Realms as part of a Presidents' Day weekend promotion across several of its games, beginning February 18.
facts.quote: Free Realms™, PoxNora™, Magic the Gathering - Tactics™, y Wildlife Refuge™ encontraran ofertas especiales exclusivas para cada juego empezando el 18 de febrero

facts.statement: Promotions across the listed SOE games, including Free Realms, were said to include bonus XP days, item discounts, and some new items; the post does not specify which offers applied to Free Realms.
facts.quote: Algunas ofertas incluyen Días Bonus XP, otros obtendrán descuentos en artículos, y algunos introducirán nuevos artículos.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a Spanish-language SOE site-wide news post announcing Presidents' Day weekend promotions across many SOE games, starting February 18. Free Realms is one of the listed games; the post gives no Free Realms-specific details beyond that offers include bonus XP days, item discounts and some new items. The year is not stated in the text.
